title: Continuity heartbeat observations use NIP-38 status kind 30315
intent: Resolve the backend/frontend mismatch for continuity heartbeat observations by aligning the heartbeat-observation symbol and all runtime behavior on NIP-38 operational status kind 30315.
observed_behavior: internal/kinds defined HeartbeatObservation as 30350 while generated frontend constants and web continuity filters used HEARTBEAT_OBSERVATION=30315. Backend serializer/catalog paths therefore risked treating heartbeat observations as a unique 30350 kind instead of NIP-38 status events scoped by tags.
intended_behavior: Heartbeat observations are NIP-38 operational status events on kind 30315. The heartbeat-observation symbol is a semantic alias for 30315 and heartbeat events are disambiguated by #domain=continuity plus heartbeat schema/d/worker tags, not by a unique 30350 kind.
scope: internal/kinds heartbeat kind constant and drift test
internal/adapters/nostr continuity heartbeat serialization and catalog projection
web continuity Nostr filters and unit coverage
out_of_scope: SBOM backend orchestration files owned by another concurrent agent
web/package.json and web/pnpm-lock.yaml owned by another concurrent agent
closing bead bahia-i89o before human verification
